rows.Kwic: 身心客塵透漏無門。迷悟且說逆順休論。

Override.AttributionNote: Admonitions for the Monastic Gate (緇門警訓), in the explicitly headed Inscription on Sitting Chan by Chan Master Foyan Yuan of Longmen (龍門佛眼遠禪師坐禪銘). Foyan Qingyuan is the exact author of the inscription line that says body-and-mind guest-dust has no gate through which to leak.
